lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li12Fe4Te4 (reduced formula Li3FeTe) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe and Te centers each adopt a tetrahedral environment with four Li neighbors, while Li centers have two geometric neighbors, one Fe and one Te. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations indicate corner-sharing between Fe and Te tetrahedra and between Li-centered 2-vertex polyhedra and Fe or Te tetrahedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites.
